Stellentreff AG currently has 935 open positions published on Frontaliere Ticino, across 6 Swiss cantons. Canton LU has the most openings (414), followed by ZH (196), TG (106), SG (60), AG (24), BE (22). By city, the locations with the most open positions are Luzern (158 openings), followed by Sursee (124), Willisau (79), Winterthur (76), Wil SG (49), Hochdorf (39). In the last 28 days, 924 new postings were published. All active positions are full-time. Published salaries for these roles range from CHF 14'700 to CHF 195'000 gross per year.
